verdict.rationale: Leaving a customer data platform with all your data is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no bulk export, no open-format dump, and no offboarding path. Warehouse Sync is documented as ingesting data from your warehouse into mParticle, which is the opposite direction. Forwarding event streams to downstream data-warehousing integrations is an adjacent capability, not an export of all your data in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
